## Reproduction / validation

## Public-release check

- [ ] No private repository names or internal-only URLs were introduced.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private user data, or proprietary payloads were introduced.
- [ ] Claims remain scoped to the available evidence.
- [ ] New prior-art claims prefer primary sources.
